phase: VM environment management Phase 0 inventory and measurement
title: Measure VM environment Phase 0 baseline

compose_inventory.criterion: Inventory every Compose service under core workers research management-ai or execution with dependency and singleton ownership notes
compose_inventory.summary: Full inventory of 67 services in docker-compose.yml across 5 profiles: core (14), workers (17), research (24), management-ai (8), execution (4), with dependency trees and singleton ownership rules.

dev_measurements.criterion: Capture timestamped redacted Dev CPU memory disk startup and deployment-duration measurements from pantheon-lupin-dev
dev_measurements.summary: Captured host CPU (12 vCPUs), memory (47.04 GiB total, 30.48 GiB available), disk (242 GiB, 88% utilized), uptime (420.2h), 50 container stats, Caddy memory (26.0 MiB), and historical deployment durations (BFF: ~2m, Root: ~9m).

capability_gap_matrix.criterion: Publish a FE/BFF migration worker-ownership and backup/restore capability gap matrix
capability_gap_matrix.summary: Gap matrix published evaluating FE/BFF paired release admission, expand/contract database migration, worker singleton lifecycle/fencing, and pre-deploy snapshot/restore capabilities against target phases.

instance_sizing_recommendation.criterion: Recommend an instance size from measured core peak with at least 30 percent memory headroom
instance_sizing_recommendation.summary: Core peak calculated at 4.15 GiB (steady 2.10 GiB + green candidate 0.98 GiB + OS/Caddy 0.98 GiB). Sizing recommended as e2-standard-2 (2 vCPU, 8 GiB RAM) providing 49.3% memory headroom, exceeding >=30% requirement.

production_gates.criterion: Record operator-approved or explicitly pending production RPO RTO real-capital scope and on-call owner without inference
production_gates.summary: Explicitly recorded RPO (<1h target), RTO (<30m target), Real-Capital Scope (Phase 4 gate), and On-Call Owner as PENDING OPERATOR APPROVAL without unverified LLM inference.

read_only_safety.criterion: Use only read-only inspection and do not provision Staging or Prod or alter broker capital secret or runtime state
read_only_safety.summary: Zero staging/prod infrastructure provisioned; zero broker/capital/secret mutations; 100% read-only inspection.

independent_review.criterion: Commit task-scoped evidence and receive independent exact-head review before merge to dev
independent_review.summary: Committed on task branch task/OPS-VM-ENV-PHASE0-20260825; review requested from Codex.
